newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian GDP rose 4.9 pct in 1995/6.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian GDP rose 4.9 pct in 1995/6.

text.p: Egyptian gross domestic product grew 4.9 percent in the financial year 1995/6, up from 4.7 percent in the previous year, according to a central bank report.
Early in 1995/6 government ministers projected that GDP would grow 5.4 percent.
The report said that the Egyptian population continued to grow at a rate of 2.1 percent a year in 1995/6.
The rate of unemployment fell to 9.4 percent in 1995/6, from 9.6 percent in 1994/5, it added.
